notes:
Email you send from HRMS now leaves only from your own mailbox. If you are HR, an admin, the CEO or the MD, every email you send from HRMS — offer and appointment letters, payslips, interview invites, document requests, birthday and anniversary wishes — used to leave from the company's mailbox with your name on it. Now it leaves from your own Google account, sits in your Sent folder, and replies come straight to you. Connect it once under Profile → Settings → Sending email: Google opens in your browser, asks for permission to send email on your behalf and to add events to your calendar (so interview invites come from you too), and brings you back to the app. Until you connect, HRMS will not send email for you — the compose screen says so and holds the Send button, and the connect screen is one tap away. If Google ever stops accepting the connection, HRMS tells you and holds your emails until you reconnect; nothing goes out under your name from anywhere else.

Sunday and comp-off duty now shows who decided. On the Admin rest-day list and on My Team, each claim carries who approved, rejected or changed it and when, with a history you can unfold wherever a decision was changed. A Super Admin's decision reads as "the Backend".

Questions inside course videos behave better: "Not now" puts a question aside with the video paused and it comes back when you press play, instead of popping straight back up. The in-app guide is updated to match.

For everybody else nothing changes.
